name: Posy
bio: Runs the counter at Petal & Purse. Talks to her tulips. They talk back (she says).

portrait.subject: a cute young florist girl with pink bobbed hair, a green apron with a coin purse pocket, holding a pink tulip in a small terracotta pot

request: Hi hi! Posy from Petal & Purse! Want to be flower friends? 🌷
hello: Yay! I'll send you bloom updates. Lots of them.
Your pots are waiting whenever you are!
about: I'm Posy! I sell flowers, I grow flowers, I sneeze near flowers. It's a great life.
how: Buy seeds, plant them in pots, wait for them to bloom and sell them for gold. Upgrade pots and soil to grow rarer flowers faster!
tips: Upgrade soil before buying more pots: faster blooms pay back quicker.
Rare seeds cost more but sell for much more. Save up!
Never leave a pot empty. Empty pots grow nothing!
chat: A bee flew into the shop and bought nothing. Window shopping, I guess.
I named today's tulip Gerald. Don't worry, it's a different Gerald.
The roses are being dramatic again. Thorns everywhere.
Watered everything twice. The cactus is furious.
nudge: Fresh seeds just arrived at the shop! Come plant some?
Your blooms are looking so close to ready! 🌸
idle: Your flowers have been growing for {ago}! I think they're ready to sell! 💰
{ago}! Your pots are FULL of blooms. Come collect your gold!
progress: You've got {gold} gold in your purse! Ooh, rare seeds money! 🌺

questions.q: Flower question! Which is the prettiest?
a: So tall! So sunny! Great pick ☀️

update: Shop news! Petal & Purse just updated to v{version}! New things to grow?
